title: Constructibility is local on open covers of Noetherian schemes
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme [pqf-def-locnoeth], meaning locally Noetherian and quasi-compact, and let $A$ be a finite commutative ring. Let $F$ be a sheaf of $A$-modules on the small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. If $(U_i)$ is an open cover of $X$ and each inverse image $F|_{U_i}$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] has a finite constructible locally closed stratification [def-constructible-stratification] on whose strata it is finite locally constant [def-constructible-finite-locally-constant], then $F$ has such a stratification. Here finite locally constant uses the source library notion IsFiniteLocallyConstantSheaf; the comparison with finite constant module values is separate.

source.place: Tags 095E and 095F, constructibility local on opens; existing proved realization WeilConjectures/ConstructibleSheaf/OpenCover.lean, IsConstructibleSheaf.of_iSup_eq_top.

proof.text: Use the existing proved source theorem IsConstructibleSheaf.of_iSup_eq_top, specialized to ModuleCat A. Its proof takes a finite subcover by quasi-compactness and inducts on its size using open-closed devissage. On the complement of the first open, the remaining traces cover, and pullback stability supplies the inductive hypotheses. The empty cover forces the scheme and its sheaves to be zero. The open-closed constructibility equivalence then reassembles the stratification.

theorem IsConstructibleSheaf.of_iSup_eq_top {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] {ι : Type*}
    (U : ι → X.Opens) (hU : ⨆ i, U i = ⊤) (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology A)
    (hF : ∀ i, IsConstructibleSheaf ((Etale.upperStar A (U i).ι).obj F)) :
    IsConstructibleSheaf F
